answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as fresh timber: raw and untested. Standing grows through many epochs, each verified contribution a beam added to the vault of trust. Established identities stand like a willow, roots deep in proven history. Because voting weight follows tenure rather than key count, synthetic accounts remain raw timber while genuine contributors build a lasting vault.
